sections.fullText: SevaDeep Monthly NGO Review- Current NGO Needs In Pune City

paragraphs: Every year, the onset of the monsoon season brings with it a list of requirements from the various NGOs that operate in our city. Today, we’d like to present to you a glimpse of some of the requirements of these NGOs, in the hope that you may be able to offer a helping hand.
In case you have items that fit their requirements, and you are able to put them up for donation, click the link under the relevant NGO and fill the details.
We will take care of the rest.

1.Shree Santraj Yogi Shikshan Sanstha- The orphanage and home for single parents and children require cooking oil, rice, pulses, vegetables and sugar. They also need school supplies like uniforms, shoes and bags.

2. Snehalaya Institute for Handicapped- The NGO takes care of around 70 children with disabilities. They need wheelchairs for children between the ages of 10 and 15. Click here for more details https://bit.ly/2Cwk4Yj .

3. Vidya Edu IX- The trust by IncubXperts helps underprivileged children avail quality education. They need ten blankets for students and a range of medicines. For more information, visit https://bit.ly/3hyhzTR .

4. Center for Agriculture and Rural Development (CARD)- The NGO operates a training centre for unemployed youngsters in the Pune region. They need three tables, 5 chairs and one cupboard. For more details, click here https://bit.ly/3eOrZ00 .

5. Ray of hope foundation- The foundation operated old age homes and supports individuals that live on their own. They require a CCTV system for ensuring the safety of their occupants. For more information, visit https://bit.ly/3fWcuEB.

Remember that we have hundreds of other NGOs that need your help on our platform. Explore the list on www.sevadeep.com . In case you are able to make a donation, fill the details and we will ensure your donation reaches its destination.
You may also reach Nitin Ghodke at +91 9518541719 in case you have any questions. Don’t forget to stay up to date on our work on Facebook.
